verdict.rationale: Brevo documents an MCP integration and states that users can manage campaigns from ChatGPT, Claude and other AI tools. It also documents segments and one-off scheduling of future sends, so an agent can plausibly create a campaign against a segment and schedule it. Nothing in the evidence shows a draft or queued state, or a human-approval gate before send, and the scheduling citation is a one-off future send rather than an approval workflow. missing for 10: documented agent creation of segment-targeted campaigns via API/MCP, a draft or pending-approval state, a human sign-off step before send, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Manage campaigns and contacts directly from ChatGPT, Claude & other AI tools
Enable AI models to interact with your Brevo account through standardized endpoints.
Create as many segments as you need.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
